recipes.name: Chili con carne
recipes.dk: Chili med hakket kød, bønner & ris
steps: Fry the chopped onion, garlic and grated carrot in the oil for 3 min. Add the mince and brown it.
Stir in the paprika and spidskommen, then the diced pepper, chopped tomatoes and drained beans. Simmer 25 min and season with salt.
Boil the rice in lightly salted water. Serve with a spoon of skyr.

recipes.name: Whole-grain spaghetti bolognese
steps: Fry chopped onion, garlic, grated carrot and diced squash in the oil for 5 min. Add the mince and brown it.
Add the tomatoes, salt and pepper. Simmer 20–25 min.
Boil the pasta in salted water and toss with the sauce.

recipes.name: Taco rice bowl
recipes.dk: Taco-skål med krydret kød, ris, bønner & grønt
steps: Boil the rice in lightly salted water.
Brown the meat in the oil with the paprika, spidskommen, salt and a splash of water. Add the drained beans and heat through.
Chop the vegetables and build bowls of rice, meat and beans, vegetables and a spoon of skyr.

recipes.name: Frikadeller with potatoes & cabbage salad
steps: Mix the mince with grated onion, egg, milk, oats, 1 tsp salt and pepper. Rest 15 min.
Boil the potatoes in salted water.
Shape with a wet spoon and fry in the oil on medium heat, about 6 min per side.
Shred the cabbage finely, grate in the apple and stir with the skyr and a pinch of salt.

recipes.name: Hakkebøf with soft onions
recipes.dk: Hakkebøf med bløde løg, hjemmelavet sovs & kartofler
steps: Boil the potatoes and the vegetables in salted water.
Slice the onions and cook them slowly in half the butter for 15 min until soft and golden. Take them out.
Shape the mince into 4 patties, season with salt and pepper and fry in the rest of the butter, 4 min per side.
Whisk the flour into the pan juices, add the milk and simmer 3 min for a sauce. Season and serve with the onions.

recipes.name: Flæskesteg with potatoes & fresh red cabbage
steps: Heat the oven to 200°C. Rub plenty of salt into the scored rind and put the roast in a tin with 2 dl water.
Roast 1½ hours until 65°C in the middle. If the rind isn’t crackling, turn up to 250°C for the last 10 min.
Boil the potatoes in salted water.
Shred the red cabbage, cook it in the butter with the diced apple, a pinch of salt and 1 dl water for 20 min, covered.
recipes.tip: Cut the rind off if you want it leaner. Leftover slices are good cold on rye bread.

recipes.name: Cabbage & mince stew
steps: Boil the potatoes in salted water.
Brown the mince with the chopped onion in the oil in a large pot.
Add the shredded cabbage, sliced carrots and paprika and stir until the cabbage collapses, about 5 min.
Add the tomatoes and 3 dl water. Simmer 20 min, season with salt and pepper, and serve with the potatoes.

recipes.name: Gyros bowl
steps: Toss potato wedges with most of the oil, salt and half the paprika. Roast at 220°C for 30–35 min.
Shred the cabbage and pepper finely and toss with a pinch of salt.
Grate the cucumber, squeeze it dry and stir into the skyr with grated garlic and salt.
Fry the meat hard in the rest of the oil with the rest of the paprika and some salt, 5–6 min. Build the bowls.

recipes.name: Tray-roast chicken & vegetables
steps: Toss potato chunks, onion wedges and vegetables with oil, salt and pepper and roast at 200°C for 15 min.
Season the chicken, add it to the tray and roast 20–25 min to 75°C in the middle.
Stir the skyr with grated garlic and a pinch of salt, and serve alongside.

recipes.name: Roast chicken legs with root veg
recipes.dk: Kyllingelår i ovn med kartofler & gulerødder
steps: Heat the oven to 200°C. Toss potatoes, carrots and onion wedges with oil and salt in a roasting tin.
Lay the chicken legs on top, skin up, and season with salt, pepper and paprika.
Roast 45 min until the skin is crisp and the juices run clear.

recipes.name: Chicken & vegetable curry
steps: Fry the chopped onion in the oil, add the karry and fry 1 min.
Add the chicken in pieces and brown lightly.
Add coconut milk, pepper and the other vegetables. Simmer 12–15 min and season with salt.
Boil the rice in lightly salted water and serve together.

recipes.name: Pork tenderloin with mushrooms
steps: Slice the tenderloin into medallions, season with salt and pepper and brown in the oil. Take them out.
Fry the onion and mushrooms in the same pan with the paprika, add the creme fraiche and 1 dl water and simmer 3 min.
Return the meat and simmer 8–10 min.
Boil the rice and broccoli in lightly salted water and serve together.

recipes.name: Chicken & broccoli pasta
recipes.dk: Fuldkornspasta med kylling, broccoli & cremet sauce
steps: Boil the pasta in salted water, adding the broccoli for the last 3 min.
Fry the chicken in pieces in the oil with garlic, salt and pepper, 6–7 min.
Stir in the creme fraiche, a splash of pasta water and the grated cheese, then toss with the pasta and broccoli.

recipes.name: Chicken soup with vegetables
steps: Put the chicken, the onion in halves and 2 l water in a pot with the salt. Simmer 30 min, skimming now and then.
Take out the chicken, pull the meat off the bones and discard skin and bones.
Add the rice, sliced carrots and leek to the broth and simmer 15 min.
Return the chicken, season with salt and pepper and stir in the chopped parsley.

recipes.name: Salmon with roast potatoes & greens
steps: Toss halved potatoes with oil and salt and roast at 210°C for 20 min.
Add the salmon and greens to the tray, season with salt and pepper and roast 10–12 min more.
Serve with skyr seasoned with a pinch of salt and pepper.

recipes.name: Baked fish with rice & vegetables
steps: Boil the rice in lightly salted water.
Put the fish on a tray with the halved tomatoes, drizzle with half the oil, season and bake at 200°C for 12–15 min.
Stir-fry the vegetables in the rest of the oil with the soy sauce and serve together.

recipes.name: Shrimp stir-fry
steps: Boil the rice.
Stir-fry the garlic and vegetables in the oil on high heat for 4 min.
Add the shrimp and soy sauce and toss 2 min until hot.

recipes.name: Chickpea & vegetable curry
steps: Fry the onion in the oil, add the karry and garlic for 1 min.
Add the drained chickpeas, tomatoes, coconut milk and vegetables. Simmer 15 min, stir in the spinach and season with salt.
Boil the rice and serve together.

recipes.name: Potato & vegetable frittata
steps: Boil the potatoes in salted water for 12 min, then slice.
Fry the potatoes, onion and pepper in the oil in an ovenproof pan.
Pour over the eggs beaten with salt and pepper. Cook on low heat 8 min.
Top with the grated cheese, finish under the oven grill until set, and serve with the salad.

recipes.name: Skyr bowl with fruit & oats
steps: Spoon the skyr into a bowl.
Top with chopped fruit and the oats.

recipes.name: Porridge with fruit
steps: Simmer the oats in the milk with a pinch of salt for 5 min, stirring.
Top with the chopped fruit.

recipes.name: Banana-oat pancakes
steps: Mash the banana and whisk with the eggs and oats.
Fry small pancakes in a little oil, 2 min per side. Serve with skyr.

recipes.name: Overnight oats
steps: Stir the oats, skyr and milk together in a jar.
Refrigerate overnight and top with fruit.

recipes.name: Scrambled eggs on rye
steps: Whisk the eggs with a pinch of salt and a splash of water.
Cook gently in the butter, stirring, until just set. Serve on the rye with tomato.

recipes.name: Yoghurt with oats & fruit
steps: Bowl, yoghurt, oats, fruit.

recipes.name: Cottage cheese on rye
steps: Top two slices of rye with the cottage cheese.
Add sliced vegetables and a pinch of salt.

recipes.name: Rye bread with smoked fish
steps: Spread a little skyr on two slices of rye.
Add the fish and the sliced vegetables.

recipes.name: Crunchy chicken salad
steps: Season the chicken with salt and fry in the oil, 5–6 min per side. Cool and slice.
Toss the shredded cabbage, vegetables and diced apple with the skyr and a pinch of salt.
Top with the chicken and serve with a slice of rye.

recipes.name: Tuna & egg on rye
steps: Boil the egg 8 min and slice it.
Mix the tuna with the skyr and a pinch of salt.
Spread on two slices of rye and top with egg and vegetables.

recipes.name: Egg & tomato on rye
steps: Boil the eggs 8 min, cool and slice.
Butter the rye thinly and layer with egg, tomato and a pinch of salt.

recipes.name: Pasta salad box
steps: Boil the pasta in salted water and cool it under cold water.
If using chicken, fry it in the oil with a pinch of salt and slice.
Mix with the chopped vegetables and the skyr, and season with salt.

recipes.name: Bean & vegetable soup
steps: Soften the sliced leek in the oil with the paprika.
Add diced potatoes and carrots, the tomatoes, drained beans and 1 l water.
Simmer 25 min and season with salt and pepper. Serve with rye bread. Keeps 4 days.

recipes.name: Potato & leek soup
steps: Soften the sliced leek and onion in the butter for 5 min.
Add the diced potatoes and 1 l water with the salt. Simmer 20 min and blend smooth.
Stir in the creme fraiche and parsley and season. Serve with rye bread.

recipes.name: Rye bread with cheese & veg
steps: Top two slices of rye with the cheese and plenty of sliced vegetables.

recipes.name: Egg fried rice with vegetables
steps: Boil the rice and let it steam dry (or cook it the night before).
Stir-fry the vegetables in the oil, push them aside and scramble the eggs.
Add the rice and soy sauce and toss until hot.

recipes.name: Stegt flæsk with parsley sauce
steps: Boil the potatoes in salted water.
Fry the pork slices crisp in a dry pan, 8–10 min, pouring off fat as you go. Salt them lightly.
Melt the butter, whisk in the flour, then the milk. Simmer 5 min, season with salt and stir in the chopped parsley.

recipes.name: Medister with creamed cabbage
steps: Boil the potatoes in salted water. Fry the medister in a little of the butter on medium heat for 20–25 min, turning.
Boil the shredded cabbage in salted water for 5 min and drain well.
Simmer the rest of the butter with the cream for 3 min, fold in the cabbage and season with salt and pepper.

recipes.name: Spaghetti carbonara
steps: Boil the pasta in salted water.
Fry the bacon crisp. Whisk the eggs with the grated cheese and plenty of pepper.
Off the heat, toss the drained pasta with the bacon, then the egg mix and a splash of pasta water until glossy.

recipes.name: Biksemad with fried egg
steps: Dice the potatoes small and fry them in most of the oil for 15–20 min until golden and cooked through.
Fry the diced meat and onion in another pan, then mix everything and season with salt and pepper.
Fry one egg per person in the last of the oil and put it on top.

recipes.name: Burgers with oven fries
steps: Cut the potatoes into fries, toss with the oil and salt and bake at 220°C for 30–35 min, turning once.
Shape the mince into 4 patties, season with salt and pepper and fry 3–4 min per side. Put the cheese on for the last minute.
Toast the buns and build the burgers with salad, tomato and onion.

recipes.name: Soft tacos
recipes.dk: Tortillas med krydret kød, ost & grønt
steps: Brown the meat in the oil, then stir in the tacokrydderi and 1 dl water. Simmer 5 min.
Chop the vegetables. Warm the tortillas in a dry pan.
Everyone fills their own with meat, vegetables, creme fraiche and cheese.

recipes.name: Hakkebøf with brown sauce
recipes.dk: Hakkebøf med bløde løg, brun sovs & kartofler
steps: Boil the potatoes in salted water.
Slice the onions and cook them slowly in half the butter for 15 min until soft and golden.
Shape the mince into 4 patties, season and fry in the rest of the butter, 4 min per side.
Warm the brown sauce in the pan and serve with the onions and potatoes.

recipes.name: Sausage pasta in tomato sauce
steps: Fry the chopped onion, garlic and sliced sausages in the oil for 5 min.
Add the tomatoes and paprika and simmer 10 min. Season with salt.
Boil the pasta in salted water and toss with the sauce.

recipes.name: Rolls with butter & cheese
steps: Warm the rolls in the oven for 5 min.
Split them, butter and add the cheese.

recipes.name: Eggs & bacon on toast
steps: Fry the bacon crisp, then fry the eggs in the same pan.
Toast and butter the bread and put the eggs and bacon on top.

recipes.name: Danish pancakes with sugar
steps: Whisk flour, egg, milk, a pinch of salt and a little of the sugar into a smooth batter. Rest 10 min.
Fry thin pancakes in a little butter, 1 min per side.
Sprinkle with sugar and roll up.

recipes.name: Leverpostej with bacon & mushrooms
recipes.dk: Rugbrød med lun leverpostej, bacon & champignon
steps: Fry the bacon crisp, then the sliced mushrooms in the same pan.
Warm the leverpostej in the oven or pan.
Spread on rye and top with bacon and mushrooms.

recipes.name: Ham & cheese toastie
steps: Fill the bread with ham and cheese, butter the outsides.
Toast in a pan, 3 min per side, until golden and melted.

recipes.name: Tuna wrap
recipes.dk: Wrap med tun, creme fraiche & grønt
steps: Mix the tuna with the creme fraiche and a pinch of salt.
Fill the tortillas with greens and the tuna mix, and roll them tight.
